description: FREE: the live track record of this miner. Every forecast was written down BEFORE its 15-minute window opened and settled afterwards from the exchange public feed, and the raw rows are returned alongside the score so you can recompute it yourself rather than take it on trust. Returns settled count, base rate, Brier skill against climatology, coverage, calibration error and a reliability curve. A backtest is a claim about the past that its author also chose how to compute; this is not that. Free.

rows.description: how many raw rows to return, max 500, default 50

symbol.description: restrict the record to one symbol

name: get_forecast_record

tool.description: the tool that produced this payload

title: Forecast track record
